ed25519_profile: strict (cofactorless, reject non-canonical A/R, S>=L, small-order A)
note: Black-box vectors: input bytes + witness + pubkeys (+ optional tape) -> expected --json. torn_bytes = len mod 128 ALWAYS (Q13.6). observed_now null means the flag is omitted. Zero Leg-1 content.

cases.name: accept_genesis_only
cases.description: Valid genesis only, no steps; observed_now omitted (Q6/Q13.1: genesis-only ACCEPTs regardless of observed_now, no expiry gate).

cases.name: accept_one_step
cases.description: Genesis + one clean step of 100 (gross 100 <= cap 500).

cases.name: accept_two_step
cases.description: Genesis + two clean steps (gross 200 <= cap 500).

cases.name: accept_cap_boundary_2p63_minus_1
cases.description: cap = 2^63-1; one step spends exactly the cap. ACCEPT.

cases.name: accept_gross_cross_2p53_and_2p63
cases.description: Cumulative gross crosses 2^53 then lands on 2^63-1 under a 2^63-1 cap (catches float drift). ACCEPT.

cases.name: accept_torn_tail_001
cases.description: Genesis + one step + 1 trailing partial bytes. ACCEPT_TORN_TAIL.

cases.name: accept_torn_tail_064
cases.description: Genesis + one step + 64 trailing partial bytes. ACCEPT_TORN_TAIL.

cases.name: accept_torn_tail_127
cases.description: Genesis + one step + 127 trailing partial bytes. ACCEPT_TORN_TAIL.

cases.name: accept_expect_tip_match
cases.description: Two clean steps with --expect-tip = SHA-256 of the last whole record.

cases.name: accept_cosigned_tape
cases.description: Genesis + two steps WITH --tape: real Ed25519 co-signatures (sig_A+sig_B per record, signed message = 32-byte record_seal). ACCEPT.

cases.name: reject_duplicate_id
cases.description: Third step replays step_id 'part-0001' -> REJECT_DUPLICATE_ID at index 3.

cases.name: reject_chain_break
cases.description: Step 2 prev_hash is 32 zeros, not SHA-256(record 1) -> REJECT_CHAIN_BREAK at index 2.

cases.name: reject_over_cap
cases.description: One step gross_spent 600 > cap 500 -> REJECT_OVER_CAP at index 1.

cases.name: reject_expired
cases.description: observed_now == expires_at (>= expires_at) -> REJECT_EXPIRED at index 1. Expiry keys on observed_now (Q6), not record_ts.

cases.name: reject_bad_seal
cases.description: Whole step record with a corrupted record_seal -> REJECT_BAD_SEAL at index 1 (NOT torn: a whole record that fails its seal is a REJECT).

cases.name: reject_not_money_2p63
cases.description: seller_amount = 2^63 (>= 2^63) -> REJECT_AMOUNT_NOT_MONEY at index 1.

cases.name: reject_genesis_cap_not_money
cases.description: Genesis cap = 2^63 -> REJECT_AMOUNT_NOT_MONEY at index 0 (cap IS money-gated).

cases.name: reject_manifest_mismatch
cases.description: Supplied manifest witness does not hash to payload manifest_sha256 -> REJECT_BAD_GENESIS at index 0.

cases.name: reject_bad_domain
cases.description: Step with domain_id = 9 -> REJECT_BAD_DOMAIN at index 1.

cases.name: reject_seq_mismatch
cases.description: Step at index 1 carries seq_no = 5 -> REJECT_SEQ_MISMATCH at index 1.

cases.name: reject_empty_id
cases.description: Step with an all-zero step_id -> REJECT_EMPTY_ID at index 1.

cases.name: reject_malformed_payload_reserved
cases.description: Step payload reserved[40..48] has a non-zero byte and the record_seal is now STALE; reserved is checked BEFORE the seal -> REJECT_MALFORMED_RECORD at index 1 (Q2c; NOT BAD_SEAL).

cases.name: reject_expect_tip_mismatch
cases.description: Two clean steps, fold succeeds, but --expect-tip is wrong -> REJECT_CHAIN_BREAK (Q10a; anchor folds under CHAIN_BREAK, no record index).
cases.note: Post-fold anchor mismatch; fail_index is null (not a per-record fold failure).

cases.name: reject_expect_tip_torn_mismatch
cases.description: Genesis + one step + 64 torn bytes; would be ACCEPT_TORN_TAIL, but --expect-tip (wrong) is checked against the last WHOLE record -> REJECT_CHAIN_BREAK (Q10b).

cases.name: reject_genesis_bad_prevhash
cases.description: Genesis prev_hash is non-zero -> REJECT_BAD_GENESIS at index 0 (Q1; overrides a provisional CHAIN_BREAK).

cases.name: reject_genesis_kind_s
cases.description: Index 0 carries kind 'S' -> REJECT_BAD_GENESIS at index 0 (Q2a).

cases.name: reject_step_kind_g
cases.description: Index 1 carries kind 'G' -> REJECT_MALFORMED_RECORD at index 1 (Q2b).

cases.name: reject_manifest_empty_deal_id
cases.description: Manifest deal_id is all-zero -> REJECT_EMPTY_ID at index 0, checked AFTER manifest-hash agreement (Q4).

cases.name: reject_manifest_wrong_length
cases.description: Manifest witness is 170 bytes (not 176); cannot hash to manifest_sha256 -> REJECT_BAD_GENESIS at index 0 (Q13.2).

cases.name: reject_key_mismatch
cases.description: Pinned --pubkeys (a.pub,b.pub) != manifest key_A,key_B -> REJECT_KEY_MISMATCH at index 0 (Q5).

cases.name: reject_bad_key
cases.description: Manifest key_A is a small-order Ed25519 point -> REJECT_BAD_KEY at index 0 (Q14). Pinned --pubkeys = badA.pub,b.pub (match the manifest).

cases.name: reject_bad_signature_tape
cases.description: Genesis + two steps WITH --tape, but sig_B(record 1) is corrupted -> REJECT_BAD_SIGNATURE at index 1 (Q11).

cases.name: reject_bad_signature_small_order_R
cases.description: Genesis + two steps WITH --tape; sig_A(record 1) carries a small-order R (order-8 point) -> REJECT_BAD_SIGNATURE at index 1 (Q11 strict profile: reject small-order R; a cofactored Ed25519 library would ACCEPT and diverge).

cases.name: unverifiable_empty_file
cases.description: Empty log file -> UNVERIFIABLE_EMPTY (exit 3).

cases.name: unverifiable_no_record
cases.description: 50 bytes, no whole 128-byte record -> UNVERIFIABLE_NO_RECORD (exit 3).

cases.name: unverifiable_usage_missing_observed_now
cases.description: Log has a step but observed_now is omitted -> UNVERIFIABLE_USAGE (exit 3, Q6: observed_now REQUIRED when >=1 step).

cases.name: unverifiable_too_large
cases.description: Two whole records but --max-records 1 -> UNVERIFIABLE_TOO_LARGE (exit 3, Q8; decided before any fold). Demonstrates the ceiling without a 128 MiB file.

cases.name: unverifiable_usage_missing_pubkeys
cases.description: Invoked with NO --pubkeys -> UNVERIFIABLE_USAGE (exit 3), decided before any record is read (SPEC 9.1). --manifest is still supplied.

cases.name: money_bound_accept_0
cases.description: seller_amount = 0 (<= 2^63-1) under cap 2^63-1 -> ACCEPT.

cases.name: money_bound_accept_1
cases.description: seller_amount = 1 (<= 2^63-1) under cap 2^63-1 -> ACCEPT.

cases.description: seller_amount = 2147483648 (<= 2^63-1) under cap 2^63-1 -> ACCEPT.

cases.description: seller_amount = 4294967295 (<= 2^63-1) under cap 2^63-1 -> ACCEPT.

cases.description: seller_amount = 4294967296 (<= 2^63-1) under cap 2^63-1 -> ACCEPT.

cases.description: seller_amount = 9007199254740991 (<= 2^63-1) under cap 2^63-1 -> ACCEPT.

cases.name: money_bound_accept_9007199254740992
cases.description: seller_amount = 9007199254740992 (<= 2^63-1) under cap 2^63-1 -> ACCEPT.

cases.name: money_bound_reject_9223372036854775808
cases.description: seller_amount = 9223372036854775808 (>= 2^63) -> REJECT_AMOUNT_NOT_MONEY at index 1.

cases.name: money_bound_reject_18446744073709551615
cases.description: seller_amount = 18446744073709551615 (>= 2^63) -> REJECT_AMOUNT_NOT_MONEY at index 1.

cases.name: demo_sabotage_replay
cases.description: Demo 4b replay: a second step_id 'part-0001' at seq 3 -> REJECT_DUPLICATE_ID at index 3.

cases.name: demo_sabotage_altered_amount
cases.description: Demo 4b alter #1: record 1 rewritten to seller_amount 10 (recomputed seal), but record 2 prev_hash points at the original record 1 -> REJECT_CHAIN_BREAK at index 2.

cases.name: demo_sabotage_over_cap
cases.description: Demo 4b over-cap: step seller_amount 600, gross_spent 800 on top of gross 200 -> REJECT_OVER_CAP at index 3 (800 > cap 500).

cases.name: reject_genesis_bad_magic
cases.description: Genesis magic != 'FV2' (seal valid) -> REJECT_MALFORMED_RECORD at index 0 (rr4 Option B: wire-envelope check runs at genesis too).

cases.name: reject_genesis_bad_version
cases.description: Genesis version != 2 (seal valid) -> REJECT_MALFORMED_RECORD at index 0 (rr4 Option B).

cases.name: reject_genesis_bad_reserved
cases.description: Genesis header reserved [6..8) != 0 (seal valid) -> REJECT_MALFORMED_RECORD at index 0 (rr4 Option B).

cases.name: reject_genesis_bad_seqno
cases.description: Genesis seq_no != 0 (seal valid) -> REJECT_SEQ_MISMATCH at index 0 (rr4 Option B: seq_no != index applies at genesis).

cases.name: reject_genesis_bad_domain
cases.description: Genesis domain_id != 2 (seal valid) -> REJECT_BAD_DOMAIN at index 0 (rr4).

cases.name: accept_records_eq_max
cases.description: Two whole records with --max-records 2 (records == ceiling) -> ACCEPT (rr4; the ceiling is inclusive).

cases.name: reject_record_ts_decreasing
cases.description: Step 2 record_ts (TS1) < step 1 record_ts (TS2) -> REJECT_SEQ_MISMATCH at index 2 (rr4; non-decreasing record_ts rule, SPEC 5.2 step 8).

cases.name: reject_genesis_step_at_index0
cases.description: A well-formed step record (kind='S', seq_no=1, valid seal) placed as the sole record at index 0 -> REJECT_BAD_GENESIS at index 0 (rr5: the genesis kind-gate precedes the seq_no check).
